execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."Feedback" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "feltUnderstood" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "fromUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "helpful" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "replyId" text NOT NULL,
  "reportReason" text,
  "tooJudgmental" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "tooMuchAdvice" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Letter" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "desiredReplyType" "ReplyType" NOT NULL,
  "emotionTags" text[],
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "maxReplies" int4 DEFAULT 7 NOT NULL,
  "processedText" text NOT NULL,
  "rawText" text NOT NULL,
  "riskLevel" "RiskLevel" NOT NULL,
  "situationTags" text[],
  "status" "LetterStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"LetterStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."LetterComment" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "letterId" text NOT NULL,
  "selectedText" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Match" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "letterId" text NOT NULL,
  "matchReason" text NOT NULL,
  "responderId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "MatchStatus" DEFAULT 'OFFERED'::"MatchStatus" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ModerationEvent" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "newStatus" text,
  "previousStatus" text,
  "reason" text,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetType" "ModerationTargetType" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Reply" (
  "coachedText" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "letterId" text NOT NULL,
  "rawText" text NOT NULL,
  "responderId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "ReplyStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"ReplyStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SupportResource" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "region" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "ageRange" "AgeRange" NOT NULL,
  "anonymousHandle" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "migrationCode" text,
  "preferredReplyType" "ReplyType" NOT NULL,
  "recentIps" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "suspendedAt" timestamp(3),
  "themePreference" text DEFAULT 'system' NOT NULL,
  "trustScore" int4 DEFAULT 50 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
